title: Adam Arras
text:
I am a postdoctoral researcher in the DYNASNET group at the Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics, working with Miklós Abért.
I completed my PhD at Aix–Marseille University under the supervision of Charles Bordenave, after graduating from École normale supérieure Paris-Saclay (formerly ENS Cachan, Master MVA).
My research lies at the intersection of probability, geometry, and spectral analysis, with a focus on large random graphs and complex networks.

Contact: arras@renyi.hu

title: About
text:
Since completing the MVA Master’s program, I have also followed developments in technology and AI, mainly through Hacker News.
There are several high-quality online courses freely available. Among them, I particularly recommend:
Mathematics and physics

Xavier Viennot’s course on bijective combinatorics
Frederic P. Schuller’s course on the mathematical foundations of theoretical physics

AI

Jeremy Howard and Sylvain Gugger’s Practical Deep Learning for Coders
